type_en: amber mosaic table clock (Art Deco)
visual_en: Tall triangular body faced with honey and butterscotch amber mosaic and raw-amber edging, round cream dial in a wood-grain bezel at left, two ring openings with suspended amber balls and a small amber pendulum disc; curved brass foot.

type_en: amber mosaic memorial block with bronze Immanuel Kant plaque
visual_en: Arched block of polished butterscotch/honey amber mosaic with a bronze plaque inscribed "Immanuel Kant 1724-1804" and his quotation; the right-hand image shows the rough back of raw amber pieces.
notes_en: Photo shows front and back side by side, probably a two-view composite of one block (this photographer often does that). If it is in fact a pair of matching blocks (bookends), it is still one piece.

type_en: amber pipe stem / cheroot holder with fitted case
visual_en: Long holder: butterscotch amber knob mouthpiece, gilt filigree collar, mottled amber section and dark wooden stem with cork end; shown with an empty navy velvet fitted case (cream silk lining).
notes_en: The empty fitted case shown with it is treated as its own case.

type_en: amber box with silver-metal hinged lid
visual_en: Rectangular box with sides of polished butterscotch/honey amber blocks framed by twisted wire, hinged white-metal lid with a band of rosettes and amber top; brown velvet interior, shown open.

type_en: amber mosaic mantel clock
visual_en: Rectangular clock faced with honey and butterscotch amber mosaic blocks, square cream "8 Tag" dial with silver chapter ring, black base.

type_en: letter rack with amber mosaic base
visual_en: Three graduated arched wooden dividers on a rectangular base of polished honey/butterscotch amber mosaic blocks.

type_en: letter opener with amber mosaic handle
visual_en: Wooden blade; handle covered in honey amber mosaic with an inlaid wood panel.
notes_en: #7 "DSC_7529 (1).jpg" is a pixel-identical copy of #8 (dupgroups distance 0).

type_en: amber candlestick with caryatid column
visual_en: Very dark cognac column carved/moulded with a standing caryatid figure between honey amber rings, urn-shaped honey amber sconce with brass pricket, round amber mosaic plate on a pale wooden base.
notes_en: Material uncertain for the column: very dark, uniform and crisply detailed, it may be pressed amber or a moulded resin rather than carved natural amber. Rings, sconce and base plate look like natural amber.

type_en: carved hen and chick
visual_en: Hen facing a chick, carved in transparent cognac-orange amber with fine feather detail, on a dark cognac base strip.
notes_en: Checked: folder holds one photo of one object.

type_en: carved meerschaum pipe (eagle) with amber stem
visual_en: Meerschaum bowl carved as an eagle perched on a leafy branch; curved butterscotch amber stem.

type_en: meerschaum pipe with monogram, amber stem, fitted case
visual_en: Meerschaum pipe with raised carved monogram on the bowl, beaded brown rim collar and butterscotch amber stem; black fitted case with purple lining.
notes_en: Monogram, rim collar and patina match in all three photos.

type_en: amber mosaic table clock (square)
visual_en: Square dial in a chrome bezel set in butterscotch/honey amber mosaic, framed by rounded polished amber blocks, on two amber block feet.

type_en: carved hen and chick
visual_en: Hen with a chick at its side on a shared base, carved in opaque egg-yolk/butterscotch amber.
notes_en: Checked: one object. Different carving from Amb-dec-005 (#10) and Amb-dec-009 (#37).

type_en: dragon relief carved in an amber nugget
visual_en: Butterscotch nugget carved in relief with a coiled dragon and foliage; the back keeps the natural orange-red crust. #17 adds a top view with a signature.
notes_en: #17 and #18 share one EXIF frame but are different edits (hash distance 97), so both are kept. Folder holds one object.

type_en: amber cigarette holder with fitted case
visual_en: Tapering butterscotch amber holder with honey rings, dark cherry tip and cream bone/ivory end; tan leather fitted case lined in red velvet.

type_en: meerschaum pipe with amber stem, fitted case
visual_en: Plain egg-shaped white meerschaum bowl with curved honey-butterscotch amber stem, in a dark fitted case with red lining.

type_en: carved amber teapot
visual_en: Teapot-form carving in butterscotch amber with branch-shaped handle and spout, decorated in high relief with flowering plum branches and birds.
notes_en: #23, #24 (=#22), #26 (=#25) and #28, #29 (=#27) in _Duplicates are pixel-identical copies (distance 0). Folder holds one object.

type_en: maker's label detail (Norddeutsche Bernstein-Industrie, Koenigsberg)
visual_en: Close-up of a metal plate "Hergestellt von: Norddeutsche Bernstein-Industrie, Naujoks, Mann & Gedenk, Koenigsberg/Pr. 1 Bernsteinhaus" on a torn maroon crocodile-embossed leather flap, on a maroon leather surface.
notes_en: Detail photo only; the object it belongs to is not identifiable. It is the last frame of S03, 7 min after the last Amb-dec-008 frame, but that modern Chinese-style teapot is an unlikely fit for a 1930s Koenigsberg label. Stylistically the Art Deco amber clock #15 (g1-12) is more plausible, but its back is not shown. None of the cases in my sessions has this leather. Owner should say which object carries this label; then move #30 into that piece.

type_en: bronze horse on amber base
visual_en: Bronze horse figurine standing on a polished cognac amber block with crust spots; original paper shield tag ("...Bernstein NBJ") tied on.

type_en: commemorative plaque with amber disc (East Prussia 1938)
visual_en: Square gilt-brass plaque engraved "Ostpreussenfahrt 14.-16.8.1938" with an outline map of East Prussia; centre set with a round cognac amber disc in a bezel.

type_en: compact with amber mosaic lid
visual_en: Round compact in a gilt rim, lid covered with faceted butterscotch and honey amber mosaic.
notes_en: Different object from the compact #102 (g1-53).

type_en: Art Deco amber mosaic desk set (4 pieces)
visual_en: Honey amber mosaic with chrome fittings: inkstand with two inkwells and pen holder, letter rack, ashtray with lighter, rocker blotter.
notes_en: Set always shown together. The ashtray and letter rack in S20 (#186-#188) are different objects (checked).

type_en: amber cigarette holder with snakeskin case
visual_en: Tapered butterscotch amber mouthpiece in an ivory/bone barrel with white-metal ring; with its snakeskin-pattern case.

type_en: bronze elk on amber mosaic plinth
visual_en: Bronze elk calf on a rectangular plinth faced with faceted cognac and honey amber mosaic.
notes_en: Not the black elk on a mosaic base in S20 (#185); different cast, patina and plinth (checked).

type_en: carved rooster and chick
visual_en: Low, elongated rooster with a chick, carved in opaque orange amber.
notes_en: Checked: one object.

type_en: cased gilt case with two amber cigarette holders
visual_en: Fitted red silk/velvet case (label "Or sur argent controle") holding a gilt-silver engraved box (vesta or cigarette case) and two butterscotch amber cigarette holders with gilt cartouche mounts.
notes_en: Set in its fitted case, one piece.

type_en: cased two-part pipe stem with silver filigree and amber ends
visual_en: Fitted leather case lined in red velvet holding two long parts with silver filigree and beaded mounts, dark shaft and butterscotch amber knob ends.

type_en: raw amber nugget with polished window
visual_en: Large nugget with thick rust-brown weathered crust; one end polished to a window showing butterscotch amber with red flow lines.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST (natural stone).

type_en: amber snuff box with gilt mounts
visual_en: Oval hinged box in darkened cherry-cognac amber with gilt-metal mounts, carved floral finial on the lid; fine crazing, screws visible inside (#45 open, #44 base).

type_en: relief-carved amber nugget (Gdansk coat of arms, 997-1997)
visual_en: Raw butterscotch nugget with a recessed carved panel of the Gdansk arms (two lions supporting a crowned shield with two crosses) under the date "997-1997"; rest of the stone natural crust (#49 back).
notes_en: K&A item, classified DEC: a relief scene carved into a nugget, filed like Amb-dec-002. #47 "DSC_9070 (1).JPG" is a pixel-identical copy of #48 (front+back composite). Unsure only for #51: a low view of a polished, flow-layered face shot 3 frames (36 s) after #50 and filed with it. Probably the base/side of this nugget, but it could be a separate nugget.

type_en: cased Pushkin souvenir set: amber plaque with miniature book + cigarette holder
visual_en: Polished cognac amber plaque with a miniature amber book inscribed "A.S. Pushkin" and an ivory quill, plus a cognac amber cigarette holder with gilt rim; black velvet case with monogrammed pink silk lid.
notes_en: Set in its original case, one piece.

type_en: amber desk seal in jeweller's box
visual_en: Pear-shaped cognac/honey amber handle on a round gilt base, in its red pebbled box printed "Juwelier F. Halder, Wien I, Reitschulg. 4".

type_en: polished amber nugget with miniature amber book
visual_en: Polished honey-cognac nugget with mossy dark inclusions, cut flat on top to carry a miniature amber book (dark cherry covers, butterscotch page block, metal clasp).
notes_en: Different object from the Pushkin set #52/#53 and from the cognac nugget #62-#64 (checked).

type_en: set of three amber mosaic lighthouses
visual_en: Three lighthouse models of different height and design in honey, cognac and butterscotch amber mosaic on amber bases, with fine wire lightning rods.
notes_en: Always shown together, so treated as one set. Could be split into three pieces if the owner sells them separately.

type_en: burl-wood box with amber mosaic lid (with amber bracelets)
visual_en: Square burl-wood box, lid inset with a honey/butterscotch amber mosaic panel; shown open (#61) with a segment bracelet of honey and butterscotch amber and more butterscotch segments inside.
notes_en: #59 "DSC_9539 (1).JPG" is a pixel-identical copy of #60. The bracelets are shown as the box contents and may be separate saleable items.

type_en: polished cognac amber nugget
visual_en: Polished translucent cognac-orange nugget with cloudy zones; one end keeps a fractured, crusty surface.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST. Not the crazed nugget in S12 #151/#152 (checked).

type_en: carved amber snuff bottle
visual_en: Snuff bottle carved in dark cherry-cognac amber with a brick/basket ground and relief figures (an old sage) on both faces; cabochon stopper. Front and back shown side by side.
notes_en: #65 "DSC_9601. (1).jpg" is a pixel-identical copy of #66 "DSC_9601..jpg".

type_en: carved lizard on rock
visual_en: Lizard with black eyes lying on a rock with honeycomb texture, carved in butterscotch amber.
notes_en: #68-#70 in _Duplicates are pixel-identical copies of #67 (distance 0). Folder holds one object.

type_en: polished butterscotch amber nugget
visual_en: Polished egg-yolk/butterscotch landscape nugget with cream and honey swirls, a dark crust channel across the face and crust along one edge.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST. RE-SHOOT: the same stone is in S29 (Jan 2023, ST loose) as #251 and #252 (identical crust channel and specks); #254 and the 4-view composite #258 are very probably it too. Those photos belong to another group's sessions and should be merged into this piece. #71 is a 3-view composite from the same frame as #72 (distance 110), not a duplicate.

type_en: amber mosaic photo frame
visual_en: Rectangular frame faced with honey/butterscotch amber mosaic with a scalloped outer edge; empty, cardboard back visible.

type_en: carved amber face pendant with silver mount
visual_en: Butterscotch nugget carved on the front with a human face and wavy hair, natural crusted back (#76); dark oxidised-silver cap mount and chain.

type_en: amber mosaic casket with bead necklace
visual_en: Casket on butterscotch ball feet: butterscotch mosaic lid with a cognac cabochon centre, transparent cognac side panels with sun-spangle inclusions; shown open with a necklace of large butterscotch beads.
notes_en: Necklace shown as contents; may be a separate item.

type_en: polished amber nugget on wooden stand
visual_en: Polished dark cherry-cognac nugget with an orange rim and pitted, cavernous crust zones, set upright on a rectangular wooden plinth.
notes_en: Owner filed it in AMB-A. It is a natural polished nugget simply set on a display plinth, not worked into an object, which matches the AMB-ST definition (and nuggets on stands are filed in ST/K&A elsewhere). Proposed ST; keep A if the owner counts display mounts as artifacts.

type_en: amber casket with Art Deco amber jewellery
visual_en: Chest-shaped casket of butterscotch/honey amber with silvered frame, hinges and hasp, brown flock lining; shown with its jewellery: carved brooch, pendant in a black/white enamel frame on chain, a pair of clips, a cone pendant and a button.
notes_en: Box and contents shown together. The jewellery may be sold separately. Different box from #91/#92 and #94 (lining and mosaic differ).

type_en: amber desk seal with monogram
visual_en: Polished butterscotch nugget handle with a crust streak, silver filigree collar and octagonal silver matrix engraved with a monogram.

type_en: amber mosaic plaque with carved head of a turbaned man
visual_en: Round/oval plaque of radial cognac mosaic with a butterscotch-and-cognac sunburst border and thick cognac edge; applied carved butterscotch head of a bearded man in a turban.
notes_en: Plaque A. Only close-up and side views; no full view in my sessions. #89 (side view, 1 min before #90) shows the same border and the ribbed turban.

type_en: amber mosaic chest box with bead necklace
visual_en: Chest box with mosaic of honey, cognac and included amber pieces, silvered hasp and frame, green felt lining; shown open (#92) with a necklace of olive-shaped honey/cognac beads.
notes_en: Necklace shown as contents. Different from #85/#86 (brown lining) and #94 (different lid/front mosaic).

type_en: amber mosaic plaque with carved plumed head
visual_en: Applied carved butterscotch head with a large plume/foliate headdress on a radial cognac mosaic with a butterscotch block border and cognac edge.
notes_en: Plaque B. Close-up only. Different plaque from A (#90: different head and border) and C (#98, grid background). A and B may be a pair.

type_en: amber mosaic chest box
visual_en: Closed chest box in butterscotch, cognac and pale yellow-green amber block mosaic, silvered hasp, small feet.

type_en: polished orange amber nugget
visual_en: Polished opaque orange-butterscotch nugget with dark brown mottled zones and small crust pits.
notes_en: K&A item, classified ST. Not the orange stones in S31 (#272-#274) or S12 (#151/#152) (checked).

type_en: oval amber mosaic plaque with carved bust of a lady
visual_en: Oval plaque: applied carved butterscotch bust of an 18th-century lady in profile with towering coiffure, flowers and plume, on a cognac grid mosaic with butterscotch border and cognac edge.
notes_en: Plaque C.

type_en: round amber relief medallion / box lid
visual_en: Round orange-cognac amber disc with a raised rim, carved in relief with an embracing couple under a tree and a figure at each side.
notes_en: Material uncertain: the uniform colour and crisp, moulded-looking relief suggest pressed amber. Probably a lid; no other part shown.

type_en: compact with radial amber mosaic lid
visual_en: Round compact with gilt frame and hinge, lid inlaid with radial wedges of honey, cognac and butterscotch amber.
notes_en: Different object from the compact #33 (g1-21).

type_en: amber cigarette holder in Verviers fitted case
visual_en: Octagonal faceted butterscotch amber holder with a pale-blue enamel band, no metal rim; black case with cream silk lining, grey plush and green oval label "Fabrique de pipes ... 16 rue Spintay, Verviers".
notes_en: #104 (holder standing before a closed black case, shot 5 frames after #103) is grouped here by shot order. The twin holder #106 is identical in design, so #104 could show that one instead.

type_en: amber cigarette holder with gold rim, Naturbernstein case
visual_en: Honey amber holder with white cloudy patches, pale-blue/black enamel band and rose-gold rim, in a burgundy leather fitted case stamped "Naturbernstein".
notes_en: Not one of the three holders in #107 (colour, clouding and band position differ).

type_en: amber cigarette holder in fitted case (twin of g1-54)
visual_en: Octagonal faceted butterscotch amber holder with a pale-blue enamel band, in a black case with tan silk and plush lining.
notes_en: Same design as #103 but a different case (tan lining, no label), so a second holder.

type_en: set of three amber cigarette holders
visual_en: Three holders with rose-gold rims and pale enamel bands: one cognac-brown, two marbled butterscotch.
notes_en: Shown together as a set.

type_en: faceted amber bead necklace
visual_en: Graduated faceted oval beads of transparent cognac/cherry amber.

type_en: enamel dish with natural amber rim
visual_en: Round dish/ashtray with pink enamel interior splashed with green, yellow and maroon, copper rim, outer wall of natural cognac amber blocks with crust texture.

type_en: enamel dish with natural amber rim (green)
visual_en: Similar dish with green enamel interior with yellow spots; rim of natural cognac amber blocks.
notes_en: Close-up only. A second dish, since its enamel is green, not pink. May be a pair with g1-59.

type_en: lot of tumbled amber pebbles
visual_en: About 150 small tumbled pebbles, mostly white/bone and butterscotch with some honey pieces and a few raw crusted nuggets; at least one drilled pendant with a metal bail.
notes_en: K&A lot, classified ST, one piece (shown together).

type_en: lot of sawn orange blocks (amber or resin?)
visual_en: About 20 sawn rectangular blocks and bars, opaque waxy orange with saw marks and some white streaks.
notes_en: K&A lot. Cannot tell the material: natural butterscotch amber offcuts, pressed amber (ambroid) stock or a phenolic/bakelite-type resin. Needs a test (UV, hot needle, salt water).

type_en: lot of mixed amber nuggets
visual_en: About 18 larger stones: polished white and butterscotch landscape stones, polished honey pieces, and raw nuggets with brown weathered crust.
notes_en: K&A lot, classified ST, one piece (shown together).

type_en: hammered brass dish with amber mosaic medallion
visual_en: Round hammered brass dish with a central medallion of honey, butterscotch and cognac amber mosaic in a brass bezel.
